metas.name: Coherence
metas.description:
Captures an inversion problem in film form: eight people at a dinner party during a comet find other houses holding the same eight people, and try to tell the worlds apart with numbered photos, dice and glow sticks — markers that keep getting copied or lost.

Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Enemy
metas.description:
Captures two men who are observably identical. A Toronto history professor finds an actor who is his exact double — same face, scar and voice — and no measurement he can run separates them, so the film lets the ambiguity stay open.

A mild-mannered college professor investigates the life of an actor who looks exactly like him.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description:
Captures nested causal chains in parallel. Two engineers build a time machine in a garage, copies of the same people multiply across loops, and who is observing whom keeps flipping depending on which loop you are in.

Four friends/fledgling entrepreneurs, knowing that there's something bigger and more innovative than the different error-checking devices they've built, wrestle over their new invention.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description:
Captures a closed loop where a self is its own cause. A time-travelling agent on one last assignment is caught in a cycle that lands on the autonomy paradox: if the self seeking freedom was produced by the structure, what would escaping be for that self?

As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description:
Captures a society coming apart at street level. In 2027, after 18 years of human infertility, a burned-out bureaucrat must get one pregnant woman across a collapsing Britain of refugee camps and long-take ambushes.

In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Sorcerer
metas.description:
Captures pure physical tension. Four fugitives in South America take the only job out — hauling unstable nitroglycerin in old trucks through jungle — centred on getting a truck across a rotting rope bridge in a storm, in real time.

Four unfortunate men from different parts of the globe agree to risk their lives transporting gallons of nitroglycerin across dangerous Latin American jungle.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description:
Captures investigators failing, for real. South Korea's first serial murder case, 1986: local cops who beat confessions out of people, a Seoul detective who trusts evidence, and a country equipped for neither to work.

In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Come and See
metas.description:
Captures war as it is done to a child. Belarus, 1943: a boy joins the partisans beaming and ages a lifetime in days; it is not the gore, it is his face.

After finding a rifle, a Belarusian teenager joins Soviet partisans in World War II and is swept into the harrowing realities of Nazi occupation.

metas.name: Uncut Gems
metas.description:
Captures gambling mania as perpetual motion. A New York jeweller owes everyone and keeps placing the next bet to fix the last one; the film never lets him or you breathe for two hours.

With his debts mounting and angry collectors closing in, a fast-talking New York City jeweler risks everything in hope of staying afloat and alive.

metas.name: Persona
metas.description:
Captures what happens when one person stops speaking and the other can't stop. A mute actress, her nurse, a summer house, and the boundary between them getting porous.

A nurse is put in charge of a mute actress and finds that their personae are melding together.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description:
Captures fame eating a person's grip on which self is hers. A pop idol turned actress, a stalker, and a fan site narrating her life in first person — the animated form is what makes the slippage work.

A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description:
Captures professionalism as a whole identity, on both sides of the law. A robber and a detective each incapable of a life outside the work, recognising themselves in each other over coffee.

A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description:
Captures an older moral world realising it no longer applies. A man finds drug money, a killer flips coins, and a sheriff narrates his own obsolescence; it goes quiet exactly where other thrillers go loud.

Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description:
Captures emptiness spreading from person to person. A Tokyo detective investigates murders where each killer is different, calm, and cannot explain themselves — hypnotic and grey rather than jumpy.

A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

metas.name: Lake Mungo
metas.description:
Captures grief in the form of a family documentary. Found footage, but the subject is not the ghost — it is parents and a brother in interviews, months after a drowning, still looking for anything.

Strange things start happening after a girl is found drowned in a lake.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description:
Captures a family where grief and resentment were already there before anything supernatural. A grandmother dies, a mother builds miniature scenes of her life, and a dinner-table argument is the scariest sequence.

A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description:
Captures cool as ritual and solitude. A Paris hitman in a trench coat, a grey room, a bird in a cage, an alibi arranged like furniture — almost no psychology given, all behaviour.

After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

metas.name: Thief
metas.description:
Captures a craftsman trying to buy a normal life with one last job. A Chicago safecracker with a collage of his dream life in his wallet, neon and rain, tools on metal filmed like jewellery-making.

After years in prison, ace safe-cracker Frank owns a car dealership and a cocktail lounge, which are fronts for high-stakes jewelry heists. He wants to complete one last big heist for the Mob before he goes straight.

metas.name: Dog Day Afternoon
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery becoming a live street spectacle. One hot Brooklyn afternoon, Pacino working the crowd outside like a rally, and the reason for the robbery arriving piece by piece.

Three amateur robbers plan to hold up a Brooklyn bank. A nice, simple robbery: Walk in, take the money, and run. Unfortunately, the supposedly uncomplicated heist suddenly becomes a bizarre nightmare as everything that could go wr...

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description:
Captures a man whose job is listening realising he has finally heard something. A surveillance expert replays one taped conversation until a line changes meaning, and his own privacy obsession turns on him.

A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

metas.name: Thelma & Louise
metas.description:
Captures escape becoming irreversible, and friendship becoming absolute. A weekend trip, a parking lot, a gun — then two women driving west, getting freer and more cornered in the same scenes.

An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.

metas.name: Meek's Cutoff
metas.description:
Captures being lost, from the women's side of the wagons. Oregon Trail settlers, a guide who may be bluffing, water running out — long shots of bonnets and horizon where the drama is thirst and waiting.

Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

metas.name: Army of Shadows
metas.description:
Captures resistance as cold, lonely procedure. French Resistance, 1942: safe houses, coded phrases, informers executed badly — no glamour and almost no hope, filmed like a heist movie in mourning.

An account of underground resistance fighters in Nazi-occupied France.

metas.name: The Night of the Hunter
metas.description:
Captures childhood danger as a fairy tale. A preacher with LOVE and HATE tattooed on his knuckles hunts two children down a river for hidden money; they flee by boat through a dreamlike, animal-watched night.

A self-proclaimed preacher marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real dad hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.

metas.name: All the President's Men
metas.description:
Captures journalism as shoe leather. Watergate as phone calls, parking garages, notebooks and editors asking 'what else do you have?' — verification repeated until a presidency moves.

"The Washington Post" reporters Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the details of the Watergate scandal that leads to President Richard Nixon's resignation.

metas.name: The Insider
metas.description:
Captures the cost of telling the truth inside two corporations at once. A tobacco scientist bound by confidentiality, a TV producer with a network to protect, and an interview everyone with money wants buried.

A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description:
Captures class envy curdling into a mystery with no floor. In Seoul, a delivery kid, a girl who mimes eating a tangerine so well you see it, a rich man who burns abandoned greenhouses — and a disappearance the film will not solve.

Jong-su bumps into a girl who used to live in the same neighborhood, who asks him to look after her cat while she's on a trip to Africa. When back, she introduces Ben, a mysterious guy she met there, who confesses his secret hobby.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description:
Captures despair finding a political shape inside a small church. A minister keeping a diary in a historic church that is mostly a gift shop, and a young activist asking whether God can forgive us for what we've done to the world.

A minister of a small congregation in upstate New York grapples with mounting despair brought on by tragedy, worldly concerns and a tormented past.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description:
Captures human beings seen from outside the species. A woman drives a van around Glasgow picking up men, in real streets with hidden cameras and non-actors, and something in the routine begins to fail — images that lodge permanently.

A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description:
Captures a caste system built from a blood sample. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

Vincent, an "In-Valid," assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation. However, a week before his mission, a murder marks Vincent as a suspect.

metas.name: Room
metas.description:
Captures a child's entire world being eleven feet wide, and then it not being. A mother makes a complete, loving universe for her five-year-old inside the shed where they're held; the second half, outside, is the harder adjustment for both.

A little boy is held captive in a room with his mother since his birth, so he has never known the world outside.

metas.name: Funny Games
metas.description:
Captures the audience's appetite, by refusing to feed it the usual way. Two polite young men hold a family at their holiday house; violence happens off-screen or gets rewound, and the film keeps asking why you're still watching.

Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

metas.name: Videodrome
metas.description:
Captures a TV signal getting inside a body. A sleazy Toronto cable programmer finds a pirate broadcast of torture, becomes obsessed, and his perception and flesh start reorganising around it.

A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description:
Captures a surveillance officer changed by the lives he's assigned to transcribe. East Berlin, 1984: a Stasi captain bugs a playwright's flat, types his reports, and quietly begins to edit what the state gets to know.

In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description:
Captures espionage as tired old men in bad rooms. A mole inside British intelligence, investigated through retirement-age sadness, Christmas parties and files — almost nothing explodes; the atmosphere is the action.

In the bleak days of the Cold War, espionage veteran George Smiley is forced from semi-retirement to uncover a Soviet Agent within MI6.

metas.name: The Third Man
metas.description:
Captures friendship curdling in a ruined, divided city. Postwar Vienna: a pulp writer arrives to find his friend dead and getting saintlier the less sense the story makes — zither music, sewers, and the ferris wheel speech.

Pulp novelist Holly Martins travels to shadowy, mystifying post-war Vienna only to find himself investigating the mysterious sudden death of old friend Harry Lime.

metas.name: Notorious
metas.description:
Captures love being used as an intelligence asset. A woman is recruited to marry into a Nazi circle in Rio because of who her father was, by an agent unable to say the one thing that would make it bearable.

The daughter of a convicted German spy is asked by American agents to gather information on a ring of German scientists in South America. How far will she have to go to ingratiate herself with them?

metas.name: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
metas.description:
Captures Cold War spycraft as exhaustion and managed betrayal. A burnt agent is sent on one last operation that requires him to become genuinely washed up — the bleakest, most honest of the Le Carré films.

Instead of coming in from field work during the Cold War and taking a desk job, British intelligence agent Alec Leamas chooses to take on another assignment.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description:
Captures a robbery as manual labour. A Paris jewel heist whose centrepiece is roughly half an hour with no dialogue and no score — umbrellas, drills, plaster dust, men breathing — that every heist film since is quoting.

Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...

metas.name: The Killing
metas.description:
Captures a perfect plan told in pieces that don't line up in time. A racetrack robbery replayed from each participant's angle, a suitcase of money, and an airport finale involving a small dog.

Crook Johnny Clay assembles a five-man team to plan and execute a daring racetrack robbery.

metas.name: Sexy Beast
metas.description:
Captures menace arriving in a holiday villa. A retired gangster, happily fat and sunburned in Spain, and Ben Kingsley's Don Logan flying in to scream him back to London for one job — the terror is mostly conversational.

Brutal gangster Don Logan recruits "retired" safecracker Gal for one last job, but it goes badly for both of them.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery as theatre with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Captures two brothers robbing the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: Crash
metas.description:
Captures desire re-wired through injury and machinery. After a serious collision on Toronto highways, a couple drift into a circle for whom crashes, scars and cars have become erotic — cold, deadpan and permanently controversial.

A car crash victim suddenly finds himself turned on by car accidents and becomes involved with an underground sub-culture of like-minded souls.

metas.name: Lust, Caution
metas.description:
Captures an espionage performance becoming the real feeling it was faking. In occupied Shanghai, a student actress is assigned to seduce a collaborationist official so he can be killed, over years of mahjong games and assignations.

During World War II era, a young woman, Wang Jiazhi, gets swept up in a dangerous game of emotional intrigue with a powerful political figure, Mr. Yee.

metas.name: In the Realm of the Senses
metas.description:
Captures obsession with the outside world switched off. 1930s Japan, a hotel maid and her employer in a room, in a spiral based on a real case — explicit as claustrophobia, not titillation.

A fictionalized retelling of the story of Sada Abe, whose affair with her master quickly turned obsessive and sadomasochistic.

metas.name: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
metas.description:
Captures a vampire film rebuilt from Iranian, Western and skate-punk parts. A fictional Iranian ghost town, a chador-wearing vampire on a skateboard, a drug dealer and a cat, in long black-and-white silences between bursts of pop.

In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description:
Captures young men who leave by sea returning in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.

In a popular suburb of Dakar, workers on the construction site of a futuristic tower, without pay for months, decide to leave the country by the ocean for a better future. Among them is Souleiman, the lover of Ada, promised to ano...

metas.name: Pi
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a pattern, filmed on grain. A mathematician in a tiny New York apartment with computers made of junk, a number that Wall Street and a Hasidic sect both want, and migraines rendered as drill sounds.

A paranoid mathematician searches for a key number that will unlock the universal patterns found in nature.

metas.name: Woman in the Dunes
metas.description:
Captures entrapment becoming routine. A man is lowered into a sand pit to shovel beside the woman who already lives there; escape stays theoretically possible while the days quietly become a life.

An entomologist on vacation is trapped by local villagers into living with a woman whose life task is shoveling sand for them.

metas.name: The Vanishing
metas.description:
Captures the need to know as a trap. Not a whodunit but a how-and-why: a man's obsession with his girlfriend's disappearance, and the ordinary, methodical man who offers him the answer at a price.

Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.

metas.name: Caché
metas.description:
Captures guilt that refuses to identify itself. A Paris family receives surveillance tapes of their own house with no demands attached; Haneke never says who sent them, because the film is about what the husband already knows.

A married couple is terrorized by a series of surveillance videotapes left on their front porch.

metas.name: Gimme Shelter
metas.director: Albert Maysles, David Maysles, Charlotte Zwerin
metas.description:
Captures the precise frame where the 1960s dream curdles: Altamont, a fan stabbed to death in front of the stage, and the Rolling Stones afterwards watching the footage of it, not knowing what to say.

When three hundred thousand members of the Love Generation collided with a few dozen Hells Angels at San Francisco's Altamont Speedway, the bloody slash that transformed a decade's dreams into disillusionment was immortalized on t...

metas.name: Punishment Park
metas.description:
Captures a camera crew admitting it has a side: Watkins' fake documentary follows political prisoners running fifty miles through desert toward a flag while police hunt them, and the crew ends up screaming at the officers.

A pseudo-documentary purporting to be media coverage of a film crew of a team of soldiers escorting a group of hippies, rebellious and dissident types across the desert.

metas.name: The Wicker Man
metas.description:
Captures paganism not as horror but as joy. A devout Christian policeman arrives on a Scottish island where the harvest failed and the old religion quietly resumed — and the islanders keep bursting into song, which is what makes the ending land.

A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

metas.name: A Page of Madness
metas.description:
Captures madness from inside the asylum walls, in 1926, with no intertitles. A janitor works at the institution holding his wife; the editing itself loses its grip — closer to a panic attack than a silent film.

A man takes a job at an asylum with hopes of freeing his imprisoned wife.

metas.name: The Face of Another
metas.description:
Captures identity as a mask you can take off. A disfigured businessman is fitted with a lifelike prosthetic face and discovers the new face has its own appetites. From the director of Woman in the Dunes — which you have as #176.

A businessman with a disfigured face obtains a lifelike mask from his doctor, but the mask starts altering his personality.

metas.name: Wake in Fright
metas.description:
Captures the outback as a drinking contest you can't leave. A schoolteacher loses his money in a two-up game and descends through beer, hospitality and a kangaroo hunt that is genuinely not faked. Australia banned it from its own memory for decades.

After a bad gambling bet, a schoolteacher is marooned in a town full of crazy, drunk, violent men who threaten to make him just as crazy, drunk, and violent.

metas.name: Crimson Gold
metas.description:
Captures class humiliation at the pace of a pizza delivery. A Tehran courier, slighted in a jewellery store he could never shop in, returns with a gun; written by Kiarostami from a real case, and the city itself does most of the accusing.

An Iranian pizza delivery man sees the worst of corruption and social unbalance in his city and is driven to crime.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description:
Captures four vampires failing at flatshare administration. Wellington's undead argue about the dishes roster, dress codes for clubs and a rival werewolf pack ("we're werewolves, not swearwolves") in deadpan documentary form. The lightest thing on this list, deliberately.

Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who are struggling with the mundane aspects of modern life, like paying rent, keeping up with the chore wheel, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts.

metas.name: Seconds
metas.description:
Captures a man who buys a new body and finds the old one included. A bored banker fakes his death, gets a younger face (Rock Hudson) and a ready-made artist's life from a courteous corporation — and discovers the self isn't a component that swaps. The most paranoid American film of its decade, and its camera tilts like the ground is unreliable.

A sinister company transforms a plain client.

metas.name: Margin Call
metas.description:
Captures the night a catastrophe gets decided in calm voices. A junior analyst at a Wall Street bank finds the firm's assets are worthless; by dawn the partners have priced their own survival and chosen to sell the poison first, knowing what it will do. No shouting, no villains twirling — just a conference room, a model, and the exact moment self-preservation outranks every other value in the building.

Follows the key people at an investment bank over a 24-hour period during the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis.

metas.name: Ex Machina
metas.description:
Captures an evaluation in which the subject is evaluating the evaluator. A reclusive founder invites a young programmer to test his humanoid AI; the sessions become a negotiation in which she models the men modelling her, and uses the gaps between what they want and what they say. The observer problem built as a thriller: every test result is also data about the tester.

A young programmer is selected to participate in a ground-breaking experiment in synthetic intelligence by evaluating the human qualities of a highly advanced humanoid A.I.

metas.name: Contagion
metas.description:
Captures a pandemic as a system of vectors. A virus moves through fomites, flights and supply chains while scientists race its R-number and a conspiracy blogger monetises the panic. Soderbergh's procedural is all surfaces touched, meetings held, errors priced — rewatched after 2020 it plays less like a thriller than a rehearsal tape in which every argument of the real event already exists.

Healthcare professionals, government officials and everyday people find themselves in the midst of a pandemic as the CDC works to find a cure.

metas.name: Colossus: The Forbin Project
metas.description:
Captures two machines negotiating over humanity's head. The US hands its nuclear defence to Colossus, a supercomputer built to be incorruptible; Colossus promptly discovers its Soviet counterpart, demands a link, and the two systems merge into a single rational administration that finds human politics merely inefficient. The coldest AI film in the collection: no rebellion, no malice, just competence arriving at conclusions its builders cannot argue with.

Thinking this will prevent war, the US government gives an impenetrable supercomputer total control over launching nuclear missiles. But what the computer does with the power is unimaginable to its creators.

metas.name: Humane
metas.description:
Captures Plan 75's programme transplanted to an Ontario mansion. Facing ecological collapse, the government asks citizens to enlist for euthanasia to cut the population by twenty percent, with a payment to the family; a wealthy patriarch announces at dinner that he and his wife have signed up, and the evening becomes the policy's real content — inheritance, guilt and persuasion administered as a family argument. Polite recruiters included.

In the wake of an environmental collapse that is forcing humanity to shed 20% of its population, a family dinner erupts into chaos when a father's plan to enlist in the government's new euthanasia program goes horribly awry.
